description: The LENSES Nature-Based Solutions (NBS) Catalogue and Decision Support Tool is a public web platform that helps planners, policymakers and stakeholders identify and evaluate 54 nature-based solutions relevant to the water-energy-food nexus. Users filter solutions by challenge (for example climate resilience, water management, natural and climate hazards), by approach (such as ecosystem-based disaster risk reduction or infrastructure-related approaches), by NBS type, by ecosystem service (including flood protection, erosion prevention and water purification) and by Sustainable Development Goal, then read technical details with key performance indicators and download structured outputs. It also offers guidance on NBS business models, an NBS cost-benefit assessment page and a glossary. The catalogue is general and global in scope, not tied to one site, and was built in the PRIMA-funded LENSES project (grant 2041). It was developed by DRAXIS Environmental Technologies with partners in the project's work package 5 and registered on Zenodo on 25 June 2025 under CC BY 4.0 (the deposit holds a screenshot, not source code); the site is free without an account. Caveats: entries are qualitative and generic, with no site-specific modelling. It supports screening of green-blue infrastructure options in climate adaptation planning; a related record is the Nat4Wat selection tool for water treatment NBS.
